caption: The drawing depicts the head of an eagle-shaped object viewed in profile facing to the left. The head, including the beak, is rendered in shades of brown, tan, and yellow, with subtle variations to represent texture and depth. The large, curved beak is predominantly light brown with yellow and tan hues on its upper side and dark pinkish-brown on the inner surfaces visible beneath the upper mandible. The eye is circular with a light gray iris, white highlights, and dark pupil, bordered by an area of grayish shading. The head, neck, and back are covered with carefully detailed brown feathers featuring lighter brown, tan, and gray tones with visible lines suggesting individual barbs and shafts; some feathers are darker, almost black. The object resembles a carved or sculpted representation rather than a naturalistic animal, with texture and seams visible on the feathers and beak. The background is plain and off-white. The artist's signature, "S. Jerome Hoxie," and the year "1918" are written below the object near the lower right.
title: Figurehead
